additions.supersedes_nothing_because: OD-33: ORACLE_BELOW_BOUNDARY compares an oracle's imports with a boundary; no rule compares an acceptance's asserted subject with the declared interface.
additions.counterexample: capability-dependency-planner revision 1 A4 asserted the next ordinal, kept private as #nextOrdinal behind snapshot()/order(); the host could not decide it.
additions.scope: Acceptance text naming a #field or private member of a ts/js (or bare) fence, by identifier or, for a multi-word name, its phrase in English.
additions.tradeoff: Chinese paraphrases of a private member are not recognised; an interface declared outside the document is not read.

additions.supersedes_nothing_because: OD-34: reader discovery covers error text and construction shape, not exported names; no rule intersects removed exports with files promised unchanged.
additions.counterexample: create-pipeline revision 1 removed runSyncMiddleware from the root while S5/A3 kept signal.test.ts assertions unchanged, and MP-T51/MP-T67 assert that export.
additions.scope: Code spans in a requirement's export removal clause (private or internal removals excluded) against owned test files named on a line promising unchanged assertions, unless that line states an export-assertion rule.
additions.tradeoff: A name is matched as a word in the test file, so a test that mentions the name without asserting the export is also reported; the finding stays advisory.

additions.supersedes_nothing_because: OD-35: no rule inspects whether a must-ship case can have a failing baseline at all; the contract had no preserve class to mark one that cannot.
additions.counterexample: create-pipeline A7 held at base 6da16be, so the host could not produce the FAIL baseline the behaviour proof demanded and stopped; capability A6 (golden equivalence) had the same shape.
additions.scope: A must-ship acceptance not in `preserve` whose text names golden output or a before/after equivalence (same as before, 改动前后, 迁移前后, 与改动前相同).
additions.tradeoff: Bare still/仍/不变 are not markers because they usually qualify one assertion inside a change case, so a preservation case phrased only that way (plugin-host-r3 A10) is not flagged.
